description: The theme's two settings. The rest of the add-on's work happens in api.js's onStartup and needs no callable surface; these exist only so options.html can read and write the prefs, which an extension page cannot do on its own.

functions.name: setLight
functions.description: Switch the palette between light and dark. Applies without a restart.

functions.name: setMica
functions.description: Turn the Mica window backdrop on or off.

functions.name: setBackdrop
functions.description: Pick the DWM backdrop type: 2 Mica, 3 Acrylic.

functions.name: setTransparency
functions.description: How much of the backdrop shows through, 10 to 100 in steps of 10.
